Name: Puffin Cliff Farm
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This farm is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7038]Puffin Cove Farm[/url] ﻿by starmops. I redesigned the entire map and added lots of new features, many of which can be toggled on or off so you can customize to your preferences.

Some of the aesthetic options require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13743]Alvadea's Tilesheets[/url], but for recolour compatibility these can be turned off.

On windy and stormy days, you will hear the ambient waves like on the beach instead of the music or rain sound.

[u]Note: The settings for forest and beach forage and mountain ore should be set before starting a new save. However, it seems like they will work mid-game as well, but only once you've restarted the game![/u]

[b]Farm Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom farm type, so no existing farm maps are replaced
[*]All grass tiles are tillable
[*]Beach tiles are tillable, but sprinklers won't work
[*]Catch ocean, mountain and river fish
[*]Lots of berry bushes (get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable bushes[/url] if you don't want them)
[*]Renewable stumps (optional)
[*]Spawn forest forage (optional, should turn off before starting new save!)
[*]Spawn beach forage and supply crates (optional, should turn off before starting new save!)
[*]Spawn mountain ores on innermost part of the beach (optional, default off, should turn on before starting new save!)
[/list]
[b]Tidal Cave[/b][list]
[*]Toggle on/off
[*]Upgrade your pickaxe to reach it
[*]Swim in pool to replenish energy
[*]Secret area with optional fishing
[*]Plantable areas
[*]Greenhouse function (optional)
[*]Caskable (optional)
[*]Warp to farm cave (optional)
[/list]
[b]Lighthouse[/b]
[list]
[*]Toggle on/off
[*]Upgrade your axe to reach it
[*]Lights up at night
[*]Three stories to decorate as you wish
[*]Panorama view on the top (optional, DaisyNiko's Tilesheets required)
[/list]
[b]Optional decoration
[/b][list]
[*]Cute puffins on the cliffs and in the water
[*]Nicer bridge (Alvadea's Tilesheets required)
[*]Pre-placed lamps (DaisyNiko's Tilesheets required)
[*]Flowers, vines, mushrooms and benches (DaisyNiko's and Alvadea's Tilesheets required)
[/list][b]
Compatibility[/b]
All recolours are compatible for a working map, but if you want all options available only the supported recolours from DaisyNiko's and Alvadea's Tilesheets will work. The custom world map patch will not be recoloured. If anyone wants to recolour the world map patch and upload it be my guest.
Warps from and to the additional cave might not be compatible with custom farm cave mods - disable the setting if so, or request me to add compatibility.
No known incompatibilities otherwise.

[b]Credits[/b]
Thanks to starmops for allowing me to redesign their map and use their lighthouse and puffin assets!

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. 1.6. is required.
